description: The converted virtual maps (export-plan-compiler.md section 4, R-086b, decision 087) on a project created with no template: one fill per texture set, in Normal at opacity 1, with only the listed channels active: s0 BaseColor field A, SpecularRoughness grey A, BaseMetalness 0; s1 the same with BaseMetalness 1; s2 BaseMetalness grey B, SpecularRoughness grey A; s3 BaseColor (0.8, 0.3, 0.1), SpecularRoughness 0, BaseMetalness 0.5; s4 SpecularRoughness 1 (uniforms in Working); s5-s7 the empty stack. Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Glossiness2, Unity4Diff, Unity4Gloss, reflection, 1/ior (file 1_over_ior), f0 and View_2D (OpenEXR 32f), the export step repeated in the same session.
